sources.title: Kushtetuta e Republikës së Shqipërisë
sources.publisher: Information and Data Protection Commissioner, Albania
sources.supports: Articles18,22and47: equality before law,freedom of expression,peaceful unarmed assembly. Context for the creator caption, not law applied to unidentified footage.

visualMethod: One source-linked qualitative diagram appropriate to an eleven-second clip: three constitutional references relevant to the caption’s freedom theme. No fabricated historical timeline or numerical comparison.

meaningEvidence: Exact published TikTok clip recovered through native Download video, bound by URL and SHA-256.

Twelve full-resolution frames at0–11s were inspected: helmeted dark-uniformed figures pass a street corner, several fall, and the sequence repeats with a red arrow and Albanian youth-themed meme text.
Complete-audio ASR returned no intelligible speech segments; its weak English language guess is not used as evidence of spoken English.
The verified creator caption supplies the Ilir/i lirë wordplay and freedom/blood/DNA metaphor. The article explicitly separates this interpretation from footage provenance.
limitations: Original country,date,participants,recording author and wider events are not established.
No cause of the falls,injury,offence,motive or outcome is inferred.
No Albanian identity of the figures or location in Albania is asserted.
Wordplay is not presented as established etymology; DNA language is not a biological claim.
sourceVideo.durationPrecision: nearest whole second; half seconds round up
sourceVideo.durationEvidence: HTMLMediaElement.duration observed on the exact public TikTok player on 20 October 2026. Native Download video saved the matching clip with ffprobe container duration 11.237007 seconds; platform and downloaded transcodes differ slightly.
